task: An investor runs a monthly SIP for 15 years (180 instalments) with a 10% annual step-up: the instalment is Rs 10,000 per month in year 1, Rs 11,000 in year 2, Rs 12,100 in year 3, and so on (multiply by 1.10 each year, no rounding). Each instalment is invested at the START of its month. The fund earns 12% a year compounded monthly, i.e. 1% per month, so an instalment invested at the start of month m (m = 1..180) is multiplied by 1.01^(181 - m) by the end of month 180. Compute, rounded to the nearest rupee: total_invested; future_value (value at the end of month 180); wealth_gained (future_value - total_invested); fv_without_stepup (future value if Rs 10,000 were invested every month with no step-up, same rules). RESULT keys: total_invested, future_value, wealth_gained, fv_without_stepup.

attempts.thought: To compute the total invested amount, I will sum the monthly SIP contributions over 15 years, applying the annual step-up of 10%. For the future value, I will calculate the compounded value of each instalment based on when it was invested. I will also compute the future value of a constant investment of Rs 10,000 per month for comparison. I will assert that the total invested equals the sum of the contributions and that the future value of the step-up investment is greater than the future value of the constant investment.
attempts.code:
total_invested = 0
future_value = 0.0
fv_without_stepup = 0.0
monthly_rate = 0.01
monthly_investment = 10000
step_up_rate = 1.1
num_years = 15
num_months = num_years * 12
for year in range(num_years - 1):
    current_investment = monthly_investment * step_up_rate ** year
    for month in range(12):
        month_index = year * 12 + month
        total_invested += current_investment
        future_value += current_investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (num_months - month_index)
for month in range(num_months):
    fv_without_stepup += monthly_investment * (1 + monthly_rate) ** (num_months - month)
RESULT = {'total_invested': round(total_invested), 'future_value': round(future_value), 'wealth_gained': round(future_value - total_invested), 'fv_without_stepup': round(fv_without_stepup)}
assert total_invested == sum((monthly_investment * step_up_rate ** (year // 12) for year in range(num_months))), f'Total invested mismatch: {total_invested} != {sum((monthly_investment * step_up_rate ** (year // 12) for year in range(num_months)))}'
assert future_value > fv_without_stepup, f'Future value with step-up should be greater: {future_value} <= {fv_without_stepup}'
